verdict.rationale: Origin (early beta) lets a team create repos, mirror them from GitHub, browse and search code at cursor.com/codebase, and share with the Cursor team, which gives a shared code hub. Version-controlled project rules and skills let a lead encode domain knowledge the whole team's agents pick up. Nothing shows a unified shared workspace that ingests team docs alongside repos as a single source of truth; that has to be assembled from separate parts. Missing for 10: a documented shared workspace combining docs and repos, a docs/knowledge ingestion feature, general availability of Origin, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team sharing.
